measures.id: Tri-County Board of Recovery and Mental Health Services Tax Levy
measures.title: Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal) – Tri-County Board of Recovery and Mental Health Services (Darke, Miami and Shelby Counties)
measures.summary: Asks whether to renew a property tax of up to 0.6 mill for 5 years, beginning in 2027 and first due in 2028, for the Tri-County Board of Recovery and Mental Health Services. The money pays for counseling and supportive services for children and adults through alcohol and drug addiction programs and mental health programs. The county auditor estimates it will collect $2,596,848 a year, or $10 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The 0.6-mill recovery and mental health levy is renewed for 5 years.

measures.id: Miami County Park District Tax Levy
measures.title: Proposed Tax Levy (Additional) – Miami County Park District
measures.summary: Asks whether to levy an additional property tax of up to 1.4 mills for 10 years, beginning in 2026 and first due in 2027, for the Miami County Park District's nature reserves, preserves, facilities and programs. The Board of Park Commissioners has committed by resolution not to collect the district's existing 1.5-mill levy if this tax is approved. The county auditor estimates it will collect $5,966,102 a year, or $49 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The 1.4-mill park district levy takes effect for 10 years, and the existing 1.5-mill levy is not collected.
measures.noMeans: The new levy is not imposed.
